_readme: Single source of truth for the resume. Consumed by frontend/pages/Landing.jsx (the web page) and by resume_pdf_generator.py (the PDF, generated at build time by build.sh). Edit this file only. Never edit the page or the generator to change content, or the two will drift the way they did before this file existed. Formatting differences between the page and the PDF are intentional and live in each renderer: dates are stored ISO here and formatted per target. The private master record this file is a filtered view of lives in ~/Documents/Notes/experience/.
_pdfFlag: Any work or project entry may set "pdf": false to appear on the website but not in the PDF. The web page has unlimited room; the PDF has to stay at two pages. Default when the key is absent is true.

profile.summary: Full-stack software engineer building AI-powered web apps, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and vector search pipelines, and accessible UI systems (WCAG). Owns 0->1 product features end-to-end and runs production releases across development, testing, and leadership.

bullets: Built a 0->1 AI proposal product as its sole engineer through the initial build, then led it as the team grew to seven, authoring the majority of commits and 64% of the code.

Rebuilt the marketing site on Next.js and built its CI/CD deploy pipeline, growing organic search from under 1,000 clicks and under 1M impressions to 52.1K clicks and 6.17M impressions over six months.
Authored and merged 70 production releases, coordinating development, testing, and leadership through feature rollout.

Built the RAG ingestion and retrieval pipeline (OpenAI embeddings, Qdrant, ChromaDB): text-embedding-3-large at 3,072 dimensions across 4 shards, a 16-worker upsert queue, and query-expansion retrieval.
Implemented a client fine-tuning pipeline on the OpenAI fine-tuning API across four model slots, with per-user token cost metering on every model call.
Built an admin prompt orchestration layer for nine production AI workflows, with live sync, code-defined fallbacks, and injection and hallucination guards.
Integrated server-hosted GIS segmentation models (SamGeo, LangSAM) for satellite imagery selection in the main app.
Added Stripe payment systems and supported site-based pricing rollout with product.
Onboarded and mentored 2 developers; participated in interviews and code reviews.
